prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-body character action concept sheet for Lumenhold Academy.
Input image 1 is the identity reference: preserve each person's face, skin, hair silhouette and colour, age, glasses, scarf/collar and upper costume. Input image 2 is STYLE AND FULL-BODY PROPORTION ONLY: ignore its character identities. Extend the committed portrait designs naturally below the chest.
Match the simple minimal storybook paper-cut style: broad flat colour shapes, smooth clean silhouettes, almost no outlines, only one simple shadow shape; no gradients, no texture, no painterly rendering, no realistic anatomy detail. Approximately 4 to 5 heads tall like the supplied full-body style reference; young adults look adult and older people show their age with a few simple lines, not babies or extreme chibi.
KEY invariant: round/oval dark pupils, with ONE CRISP BRIGHT WHITE CATCHLIGHT clearly INSIDE EACH pupil. Both eyes readable even in action and behind glasses; no closed eyes, no blank silver eyes, no tiny anime slit eyes. A coloured iris is only a thin rim around a dark highlighted pupil.
Composition: ONE horizontal row of separate full-body figures on a plain warm ivory background. Show every head, all limbs, hands and footwear fully within the image. Leave generous space around each action and prop; do not overlap neighbouring characters or merge their actions. Preserve plausible standing proportions and sizes when someone kneels, sits or bows. Full-body means complete figures in the specified active poses, not portrait busts. Keep actions clear and varied rather than generic standing poses. Faces remain front or three-quarter facing so the approved designs and eye glints can be recognised. No scene background, no text or labels, no extra people; only each action's small necessary props or named animal. Traditional modest academy tunics/robes, practical trousers or skirts and sturdy shoes extend the existing costumes; keep silhouettes simple. Adult faculty and village workwear should suit their roles, and Northern fur coats stay recognisable.
Exactly 5 characters, in this exact left-to-right order:
1. Lyra Vaneshade (19, she/her). Appearance: Pale, long straight crimson hair, a narrow face and sharply arched brows; a neat crimson shoulder cape over academy navy. Proud, exacting noble pyromancer. Action: A forward duelling lunge, directing a small flame from her wand; her crimson shoulder cape swings back.
2. Tobias Fennick (19, he/him). Appearance: Pale, short ginger crop, a broad square face and very broad shoulders; a worn green collar over plain academy clothes. Gentle farm boy with an open, slightly sheepish smile. Action: Kneeling on one knee, carefully watering a small potted herb, his free hand supporting its delicate stem. Make his broad shoulders and large gentle hands clear.
3. Seraphine Hale (19, she/her). Appearance: Pale, slight face; loose ivory hair framing the cheeks, silver-grey irises around dark highlighted pupils, and a dark blue scarf with a few large stars. Dreamy, perceptive seer. Action: Seated cross-legged on a low cushion, turning a tarot card over a small spread; her head is lifted in a dreamy, perceptive glance. Keep both feet and her star scarf visible.
4. Corvin Ashby (19, he/him). Appearance: Warm tan, dark brown hair swept into a small high knot, a lean angular face and crooked grin; an open navy collar and charcoal scarf. Charming, reckless passage-finder. Action: In a low crouch, picking the lock of a small wooden chest, with a crooked grin directed toward the viewer; his charcoal scarf trails behind.
5. Mir Ten (19, they/them). Appearance: Copper-brown skin, wild brick-red hair, brass goggles pushed above the forehead, a round face and an eager grin; teal apron straps over academy navy, one soot smudge. Curious clockworks inventor. Action: Leaning forward in an eager, slightly off-balance step, tightening a small spanner on their brass clockwork owl perched on their other forearm. Goggles stay above the eyes.
All figures complete, including seated/crouching feet. Keep every white pupil highlight visible.

Exactly 5 characters, in this exact left-to-right order:
1. Nessa Quill (19, she/her). Appearance: Deep brown skin, dark hair in a large high bun with a short side fringe, a heart-shaped face and keen raised brows; ochre lapels and a small ink mark on her nose. Bold, overworked student editor. Action: Striding briskly into an interview with an open notebook in one hand and an emphatic pointing gesture in the other; her self-writing quill floats beside the notebook.
2. Bram Hollis (19, he/him). Appearance: Warm tan, a clipped blond crop, a broad square jaw and heavy angled brows; a red prefect sash across a stiff navy collar. Officious and insecure behind a tight, self-important mouth. Action: Planting his boots wide to block a corridor, an open demerit ledger in one arm and his other palm raised in an officious stop gesture.
3. Kael Dumont (20, he/him). Appearance: Pale, short ivory hair with an angular fringe, a long narrow face and restrained blue-grey eyes with dark highlighted pupils; dark slate fur-lined collar, a little frost at the lashes. Guarded Northern transfer. Action: Half-turning in a guarded backward step, quietly forming one small snowflake above his open palm while his other hand pulls his dark fur-lined coat close.
4. Ilse Dumont (18, she/her). Appearance: Pale, long straight ivory hair, a small pointed face and the same blue-grey eyes as Kael, with dark highlighted pupils; a high collar of white fur. Fierce, wary Northern outsider. Action: Braced in a sharp duelling stance, drawing an angular hexagon of frost with a wand; her white furs swing with the movement.
5. Tamsin Reed (19, they/them). Appearance: Warm brown skin, short choppy golden hair, a slim triangular face, prominent ears and a sly asymmetric smile; a green Thornwick collar. Curious illusionist raised around travelling theatre. Action: Making a theatrical half-bow, sweeping a paintbrush to conjure a little floating green illusion ribbon; a folded pen-pal letter is tucked in their free hand.
All figures complete, including seated/crouching feet. Keep every white pupil highlight visible.

Exactly 4 characters, in this exact left-to-right order:
1. Headmistress Isolde Marrow (57, she/her). Appearance: Pale, long straight black hair with faint grey temples, a long oval face, thin oval spectacles and a high plum collar. A calm, watchful headmistress whose slight smile carries authority. Action: Leaning forward just enough to place a crystal tower chess piece on a small board on a narrow pedestal beside her; the other hand rests behind her back.
2. Professor Aldric Thorne (68, he/him). Appearance: Pale, short swept-back grey hair, a pointed grey beard, a long jaw scar and severe brows; a high charcoal collar edged in muted indigo. Exacting elderly arcana teacher with watchful, humane eyes. Action: In a firm teaching stance, projecting a pale shell-shaped ward from one open palm, the other hand held behind his back; stern precision rather than an aggressive attack.
3. Old Maud (81, she/her). Appearance: Warm brown, wispy ivory hair in an untidy cheek-length halo, small round spectacles and a deeply lined round face; a frayed moss-green shawl. Kindly, sharp-eyed eighty-one-year-old hedge-witch. Action: Lifting a honey frame from a little hive, chatting to a few silvery bees; her beekeeping hat has its veil folded back so her wispy hair, spectacles and face remain visible.
4. Sister Amaranth (54, she/her). Appearance: Dark warm brown, close-cropped copper hair, narrow rectangular spectacles and a firm rectangular face; a starched white apron over claret clothing. Severe, dependable middle-aged healer with a small reassuring smile. Action: Striding purposefully on infirmary rounds, carrying a tray of tonic bottles in one hand and pointing firmly toward an unseen bed with the other.
All figures complete, including seated/crouching feet. Keep every white pupil highlight visible.

1. Professor Hedda Brask (61, she/her). Appearance: Deep brown weathered skin, a shaggy grey crop, broad cheekbones and heavy straight brows; a thick leather apron collar over earth-coloured clothing. Dry, brave older beastcraft professor. Action: Bending in a respectful small bow to an old barn owl perched on a low wooden block, offering a morsel in an open palm.
2. Professor Ottilie Vey (46, she/her). Appearance: Warm tan, long blue-black hair framing a tapered face, one elegantly lifted brow and an amused smile; a violet coat and broad violet scarf. Sly, theatrical middle-aged illusion teacher. Action: Making an elegant theatrical flourish, fanning a few playing cards in one hand while revealing an illusory teacup above the other, with one eyebrow lifted.
3. Professor Ines Marisol (39, she/her). Appearance: Warm dark brown, tousled chestnut hair around a soft oval face, a floppy blue rain hat tipped back clear of her eyes, and a lake-blue collar. Warm, weather-loving tidecaller with a delighted smile. Action: Balancing barefoot on a small curling wave, guiding it with one hand while holding an open poetry book in the other; hat tipped back and face delighted. Both feet remain visible above the water.
